body.objective: Add exact Ore-algebra, recurrence discovery and holonomic-proof machinery so Conflux can turn finite harmonic evidence into candidate general-ell or general-order theorems and then discharge them independently. The immediate consumers are sf:program/work/black-hole-general-l-structural-extension, sf:program/work/bridge-harmonic-taub-sign-generalization and the all-m/all-ell residual-atlas families. At present the teams either derive each harmonic separately or guess a rational formula by inspection; neither is a scalable proof pipeline.
body.stop_condition: Provide univariate and bounded multivariate Ore operators for shifts and derivatives with rational-function coefficients; annihilator arithmetic, GCRD/LCLM, closure under sums/products and selected definite sums/integrals, recurrence guessing with held-out validation, singular-index and initial-data ledgers, creative telescoping for a certified bounded class, and induction certificates proving a conjectured sequence/formula for all admissible indices. Reproduce Wigner/CG recurrences, infer and prove one general-ell compact-product coefficient from independently generated low-ell data, and derive or refute one Schwarzschild parity-shared recurrence. Conflux may propose an annihilator from data, but the final certificate must verify the operator identity symbolically and check enough exact initial conditions.
body.forbid: no interpolation or sequence fitting called a theorem; no recurrence accepted without singular-index analysis and sufficient initial data; no finite ell range presented as all ell; no unproved analytic continuation across exceptional harmonics; no producer data reused as the sole verifier; no opaque external CAS transcript as the certificate
notes: Priority A. This directly converts the programme's high-volume exact fixtures into general theorems rather than more tables.
The initial supported Ore class may be rational shift recurrences and scalar differential operators; matrix and q-difference extensions can follow measured demand.
